**DK29.8A** is a medical diagnosis code representing acute hemorrhagic duodenitis (akut blødende duodenitis). Within the Danish healthcare system, this code serves as a critical data point for tracking severe complications in patients with [[atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1] [^src3]. It is systematically referenced in the national clinical quality indicators and annual reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

The primary significance of DK29.8A lies in its use for calculating the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) among atrial fibrillation patients [^src3]. To accurately capture the incidence of severe bleeding, the national registries utilize a broad spectrum of ICD-10 diagnosis codes covering various anatomical systems [^src1]. DK29.8A is specifically categorized under gastrointestinal bleeding, forming part of a code range that spans from [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] to DK29.8A, alongside codes from [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] to [[dk92-2|DK92.2]] [^src1]. 

This methodological definition ensures standardized data collection and cross-regional comparison across Denmark [^src1] [^src2]. The code's inclusion in the technical reference definitions for indicators has remained consistent across the 2023, 2024, and 2025 iterations of the 'Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark' reports, underscoring its established role in cardiovascular quality measurement and pharmacovigilance (e.g., monitoring bleeding risks associated with anticoagulant therapy) [^src1] [^src2] [^src3]. Other bleeding categories tracked alongside gastrointestinal events include intracranial bleeding (e.g., [[di60|DI60]] to [[ds066|DS066]]) and urinary/pulmonary bleeding [^src1].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
